main_text.p: Magnus ad naturalem cuiusque, duplex: Nempe,
Consideratur uterq;, tum ad moderatum, tum ad naturalem cuiusque,
main_text.l: Vel in sanis, qui ab omni motu sint liberi:
Vel in ijs, quibus motus aduentitius est coniunctus:
Vel quibus recēs aliqua externa sit alteratio.
main_text.p: Magnus ad moderatum in sanis, ab omni motu liberis:
Magnus ad naturalem cuiusq; in eisdem:
Si non maior factus, sed tantum uideatur,
In quibus adiuctus est aduentitius motus:
main_text.l: Motus, cui pulsus magnus est familiaris, vi

page.notes: The word "Aut," at the right of the line "Temperamentum annunciat:" and the "D" below the text are as printed. Faint show-through from the facing page is ignored. The text is transcribed as printed, including old spellings and the "Etoriam" line; "Vel in aegrotantibus" is read as printed, with the letter g partly obscured.
